project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript strict
build_system: Next.js 16 (Turbopack by default in next dev and next build). No custom webpack config found. @tailwindcss/postcss v4. Breaking change: params/searchParams/cookies/headers are async-only — NOT relevant to this task (no dynamic route params used in nav components).
test_framework: Playwright (tests/). No unit test framework found. Navigation components have no existing unit tests.
test_command: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) then npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run typecheck` — must exit 0. 2. Run `npm run build` — must exit 0. 3. Start server with `npm run dev` and manually verify: utility bar collapses on scroll, interactive states are distinct, 6 menus open with correct layouts.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Dev server typically on port 3000. Do not restart a running dev server — start a new one if needed for verification.
contribution_requirements: Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code. TypeScript strict mode — no implicit any, no type assertions without justification.
key_patterns: CSS written in src/app/globals.css as @layer utilities custom classes — no CSS modules, no Tailwind component classes. Component-level SVG icons defined inline (see src/components/platforms/PlatformIcons.tsx pattern). Navigation content is pure TypeScript data in src/content/header-navigation.ts. All nav components are 'use client'. useId() used for accessible IDs. `inert` attribute used on hidden panels.
directory_structure: src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages. src/components/navigation/ — MegaMenu, MegaMenuVisual, DesktopNavigation, MobileNavigation. src/components/layout/ — SiteHeader, AnnouncementBar, BrandLogo, SiteFooter. src/components/projects/ — project page components (ProjectDomainsShowcase has id='domaines-projets'). src/content/ — pure TS data files (header-navigation.ts, expertise-page.ts, projects-page.ts). src/types/ — TypeScript type definitions. public/assets/images/ — images referenced in content.
